title: Design-system tabs
blurb: A <ds-tabs> component combining a closed-shadow sliding indicator, slotted light-DOM tab panels, element-scoped startViewTransition(), and directional view transition types.
question: Can a closed-shadow design-system component coordinate its internal active indicator with slotted light-DOM panels inside one element-scoped transition without leaking ::part()?
result: The component passes its private #root to this.startViewTransition({ shadowRoots: [this.#root], types }) so internal and slotted nodes share one scoped transition (not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 / Chromium 157 (flag inactive); not verified in Chrome 160
